1.20.1.1.1.0: Operators can now add, edit and delete recipes in game (DV menu, or Mods → Config): shaped, shapeless, furnace, smoker, blast furnace, campfire and stonecutter. Pick items by clicking them into the grid; recipes are saved as a data pack inside the world and load at once, for every player and in JEI. Recipes of the game and of other mods can be switched off too: put the item in the result slot and press Switch off; pick it in the list and press Enable to bring it back. New recipe: shears in the middle and 8 rotten flesh around them make 8 leather; the shears lose 8 durability.
